newsitem.title: USA: Thermogas makes acquisition in Northeast Oklahoma.
newsitem.headline: Thermogas makes acquisition in Northeast Oklahoma.

text.p: MAPCO Inc said Friday its retail propane marketing business, Thermogas Co, has acquired Kemco Fuels Inc, which has retail facilities in the northeast Oklahoma communities of Chelsea, Claremore, Coweta, Oologah and Skiatook.

Kemco markets propane to residential customers, along with gasoline and diesel fuel, to commercial customers such as contractors, construction companies, school districts and warehouses. In 1996, Kemco marketed 1.7 million gallons of propane and 3 million gallons of gasoline, diesel fuel and lubricants.
The Kemco acquisition, for undisclosed terms, is the third for Thermogas over the past 30 days, MAPCO noted.
